meta.title: Burn Room
meta.description: TZJ interlocking insulation liner system — calcium silicate liners engineered for live-fire training, heat-resistant, low-maintenance, rated for temperatures up to 1100°C.

hero.title: Insulation liners that truly withstand extreme heat
hero.description: As live-fire training grows more intense and demanding, TZJ burn rooms deliver safe, realistic training environments you can rely on.

overview.title: Calcium silicate — the optimal choice for live-fire training
overview.description: Advances in materials make calcium silicate a practical balance of durability and heat resistance. TZJ interlocking liners are our latest development, purpose-built for burn rooms that support live-fire training.
overview.lead: The interlocking tile system combines the hardest calcium silicate surface with factory-grade waterproof polymer to stand up to day-after-day live-fire training.
overview.body: Insulation performance is exceptional — during an interior burn, you can touch the exterior wall without being burned.

liner.title: Thermal performance with easy replacement
liner.description: Expansion joints between tiles allow independent movement and inspection; staggered mounting channels maximize airflow to maintain the insulation envelope through rapid heat cycles.

specs.why: Over-engineered continuous rating provides a high safety margin for fire training
At ~540°C exposure, protects all structural surfaces per live-fire training standards
Strong long-term resistance to abrasion, scraping, and hose stream impact

linerFeatures: Protects metal, masonry, and concrete structures
Suitable for new builds, retrofits, or damaged structure repair
No restriction on fire source placement within the room
No freeze-thaw issues; no drying period between sessions

comparison.title: Retrofit legacy burn rooms for tomorrow's training
comparison.description: Whatever the existing condition, our interlocking tile system can transform aging burn rooms into modern training facilities. Calcium silicate tiles protect concrete, steel, or container structures at temperatures up to 1100°C.
comparison.linkText: View liner comparison and retrofit process
steps: Install mounting channels and cover with insulation buttons to protect channels and set panel spacing.
Before retrofit: burn room interior without liner tiles installed.
After retrofit: liner tiles form a complete insulation envelope with an additional air layer between panels and walls.
